Context: Salient features of the Matrix.-

- (v) The matrix is symmetrical. Equal weightage has been given to Risk and Hardship.
- (vi) If the severity of risks / hardship decreases, we move from left to right or top to bottom and the rates of allowance follow the same path.
- (vii) The matrix only aims to compensate for risk and hardship faced. It does not determine status in any way.
- Paras. 8.10.62 to 8.10.66 of VII CPC Report  
Areas eligible for grant of Special Compensatory (Remote Locality) Allowance subsumed in Tough Location Allowance I
